guide: Open Start and type your practice name and your targets in the yellow cells: Net collection target (95% by default), most Days in A/R, days to pay an invoice, late-cancel fee share, deposit, card fee and write-off limit.

Check Team, Fee Schedule and Sliding Scale Bands. Fees are per session, before tax. Sliding scale: a lower fee set from the client's means. Late cancel: under 24 hours' notice. Co-pay: the client's part when a payer covers the rest.
Record each month's invoices on Invoices and each payment on Payments. Balance, days overdue, A/R aging band and payment timing fill in by themselves.
Open AR Aging by Client and AR Aging and Chase-first List every week: the five clients to chase first are ranked by overdue balance times days past due.
Log every promise to pay on Payment Promises and every reminder on Payment Reminders. Use the Payment Reminder Schedule to see which reminder is due.
Set up payment plans on Payment Plans and record each instalment on Plan Instalments. A late instalment shows red.
Sell prepaid packages on Packages: sessions left, value left and the 30-day expiry check fill in. Prepaid Balance Check says whether the sessions can still be delivered.
Use Sliding Scale Assessments and the Sliding Scale Calculator to agree a fee and a review date; Concession Budget shows what the sliding scale costs a year.
Close each month on Monthly Billing Summary: Client payment collection rate, Net collection rate and Days in A/R. Collection Gap by Cause shows where the money went.
Use the 18 decision tools: each ends with a verdict and a what-if table. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready messages.

Why a workbook: one flat price, no per-clinician fee, and your data stays with you in your own file. The workbook holds status and amounts only, never note content. Check your own local rules for records and tax.

listing.title: Therapy Practice Client Accounts Excel Template: A/R Aging, Invoices, Payment Plans, Packages, Sliding Scale, KPI Dashboard
listing.headline: Know who owes what, chase the right clients first and close each month in Excel
listing.description:
Run client fees, invoices, payments and balances in one Excel workbook. Built for a small group practice of talking therapists and counsellors: an owner-clinician, employed clinicians, contract (self-employed) clinicians, an associate who works under supervision and a billing coordinator.

Invoices record the client's share, the deposit applied and late-cancel fees, and work out the balance, days overdue, A/R aging band (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+) and whether each invoice was paid on time. AR Aging by Client ranks the clients to chase first by overdue balance times days past due; Payment Promises, Payment Reminders, Payment Plans and Plan Instalments follow every balance to the money. Packages track prepaid sessions, value left and expiry; Sliding Scale Bands and Assessments set a lower fee agreed from the client's means with a yearly review; Fee Schedule and Fee Rise Notices carry the yearly rise; Write-offs and Card Fees by Month complete the accounts. Monthly Billing Summary gives the Client payment collection rate, the Net collection rate and Days in A/R, and Collection Gap by Cause shows where the money went.

18 decision tools answer weekly questions with a verdict and a what-if table: session fee quote, sliding scale calculator, package price builder, chase-first list, payment plan builder, reminder schedule, card on file effect, fee rise impact with the break-even share of clients lost, write-off decision, collection forecast with a Base / Best / Worst switch, net collection rate check and more. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages.

This is part three of the Therapy Private Practice suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, one flat price with no per-clinician fee, your data stays with you, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data. The workbook holds status and amounts only, never session notes, and it does not promise results.

signature.name: Send correct invoices every month
signature.why: The client's share, late-cancel fees and the deposit applied give the amount due, the due date and a send-or-check verdict.

signature.name: Chase the five clients who owe most first
signature.why: Balance by age band (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+) and Days in A/R, ranked by overdue balance times days past due.

signature.name: Remind late payers on time
signature.why: Three reminder dates, the final notice date and today's action from the due date and any promised date.

signature.name: Set up a payment plan that fits
signature.why: The instalment and the last date, with a fit check against a quarter of a month of the client's fees.

signature.name: Watch prepaid packages before they expire
signature.why: Sessions left, prepaid value left and the packages expiring in 30 days.

signature.name: Set a fair sliding-scale fee
signature.why: Income per person finds the band, the share of the fee and the review date a year later.

signature.name: See what a fee rise changes
signature.why: The yearly revenue change and the share of clients you can lose and still break even.

signature.name: Decide: chase, plan or write off
signature.why: Balance, days overdue, client status and broken promises give the chance of recovery and a verdict.

signature.name: Forecast collections week by week
signature.why: Your prompt, normal and slow payers turn invoices into money expected each week: base, best and worst.

signature.name: Check net collection against target
signature.why: Net and client payment collection rates, and the gap to target in money, against last month and last year.

signature.name: Compare card on file with bank transfer
signature.why: What a card on file saves in chasing against the card fee, and the yearly saving from bank transfer.

signature.name: Close the month in one view
signature.why: Sessions charged, invoiced, collected and owed each month, with Days in A/R and the age bands.

competitors.lacks: print one invoice but have no balances, A/R aging, Days in A/R, deposits or late-cancel fees
charge per clinician and keep your data in their system, with no editable collection targets, chase-first rank or what-if tools
record money in but cannot age balances, log payment promises, run payment plans or forecast collections
know nothing of sliding scale, packages, late-cancel fees or the Net collection rate and its gap by cause
bill a fee but never compare Client payment collection rate with Net collection rate or warn when a package discount is too deep

These are sample terms; adapt them to your own practice and check your own local rules.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Package terms and receipt
paragraphs: Package receipt {col:packages.package_id} of {set:company}, dated {today}. Client: {col:packages.client}.
Package: {col:packages.kind}, price {col:packages.price}, paid for on {col:packages.bought_on}. Valid until {col:packages.expires_on}.
Sessions used: {col:packages.used}. Sessions left: {col:packages.sessions_left}, worth {col:packages.value_left}. Status: {col:packages.status}.
A late cancel (less than {set:late_cancel_hours} hours' notice) uses a session of the package. Sessions not used by the expiry date lapse unless we agree otherwise in writing.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Sliding scale agreement
paragraphs: Sliding scale agreement of {set:company}, dated {today}. Client: {col:assessments.client}. Reference {col:assessments.assess_id}.
A sliding scale is a lower fee agreed from the client's means. Assessed on {col:assessments.date} for a household of {col:assessments.household_size}, income band {col:assessments.income_band}.

Share of the fee agreed: {col:assessments.share_agreed}. Fee per session for {col:assessments.service}: {col:assessments.fee_per_session}. The fee will be reviewed on {col:assessments.review_date}. Review check: {col:assessments.review_check}.
The client agrees to tell us if their means change and to give the details we ask for at each review.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Fee schedule for clients
paragraphs: Fee schedule of {set:company}, year {col:fees.year}, dated {today}. Fees are per session and before any tax.

Intake assessment {col:fees.fee_intake}. Individual session {col:fees.fee_individual}. Extended individual {col:fees.fee_extended}. Couples session {col:fees.fee_couples}. Family session {col:fees.fee_family}.
Child session {col:fees.fee_child}. Speech therapy {col:fees.fee_speech}. Behaviour therapy {col:fees.fee_behaviour}. Review session {col:fees.fee_review}.

A cancellation with less than {set:late_cancel_hours} hours' notice (a late cancel) is charged {set:late_fee_pct} of the session fee. Invoices are due {set:invoice_days} days after they are issued. Ask us about a sliding scale or a package of sessions.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Fee rise letter with the notice period
paragraphs: Fee notice of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:fee_notices.client},

From {col:fee_notices.effective_date} the fee for {col:fee_notices.service} will change from {col:fee_notices.old_fee} to {col:fee_notices.new_fee}, a rise of {col:fee_notices.rise_share}. We sent this notice on {col:fee_notices.sent_on}, {col:fee_notices.notice_days} days before the change.
Fees are reviewed once a year to cover our costs. If the new fee is a problem, please talk to us about a sliding scale or a package. Reference {col:fee_notices.notice_id}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Write-off note for the records
paragraphs: Write-off note {col:writeoffs.writeoff_id} of {set:company}, dated {today}.
On {col:writeoffs.date} the balance of {col:writeoffs.amount} on invoice {col:writeoffs.invoice_id} of {col:writeoffs.client} was written off. Reason: {col:writeoffs.reason}.
Approved by {col:writeoffs.approved_by}. Balances above {set:writeoff_limit} need the owner. Keep this note with the account records; check your own local rules for how long.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Monthly billing and A/R aging report
paragraphs: Billing report of {set:company} for invoices issued in {col:billing.month}, dated {today}.

Sessions charged: {col:billing.sessions_charged}. Invoiced: {col:billing.invoiced}. Concessions given: {col:billing.concessions}. Collected: {col:billing.collected}. Written off: {col:billing.written_off}. Owed at month end: {col:billing.outstanding_end}.

Client payment collection rate: {col:billing.collection_rate}. Net collection rate: {col:billing.net_rate} (target {set:net_collection_target}). Days in A/R: {col:billing.days_in_ar} (maximum {set:max_days_ar}).

A/R aging at the month end by days since the invoice was issued: 0 to 30 days {col:billing.ar_0_30}; 31 to 60 days {col:billing.ar_31_60}; 61 to 90 days {col:billing.ar_61_90}; over 90 days {col:billing.ar_90p}.
